name: ClearButton
purpose: Icon-only convenience action for the familiar Clear utility.
knownLimitations: Avoid as a substitute for labelled business actions; use only for the matching familiar utility action.

angular.setup:
import { provideVyrnForge } from "@vyrnforge/ui-angular";
// add provideVyrnForge() to bootstrapApplication providers

useWhen: Use when an icon-only Clear action is conventional and the default Clear label accurately describes the action.
avoidWhen: Avoid for labelled business actions or when Clear does not precisely describe the result.
accessibilityNotes: Defaults aria-label and tooltip to "Clear"; callers may override aria-label when the context requires a more specific accessible name.
aiUsageNotes: Use only for the familiar Clear utility action; prefer Button or IconButton for other actions.
